dependencyGraph.description: Per-trace dependency mini-map from CLIENT spans. Null when spans are absent (logs-only).

callCount.description: Number of CLIENT spans that produced this edge.

errorCount.description: CLIENT spans on this edge with status error.

DependencyGraph.description: Per-trace dependency mini-map: unique nodes plus aggregated edges.

id.description: Stable node key (service name, or db:… / external:…).

DependencyNodeKind.description: Role of a node on a per-trace dependency mini-map (camelCase wire).

HealthStatus.description:
Per-provider health status. `Tessera.Host` aggregates per-provider
reports into a composite endpoint response.

LogEntry.description:
A single log entry. May be correlated with a trace (TraceId? LogEntry.TraceId) and/or
span (SpanId? LogEntry.SpanId). IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> LogEntry.Fields carries structured key-value
attributes attached at log emission time.

LogLevel.description:
Log severity level. Maps to OpenTelemetry LogLevel + syslog severity.
                Member names are the OTel SeverityText spellings
(INFO / WARN), not the .NET
Information / Warning ones. They travel to the wire
verbatim (camelCased) and every consumer — the TypeScript union and
the .log-level-* CSS classes it composes by name — keys off
those spellings, so renaming a member here silently unstyles a
severity in the UI.

oneOf.description:
Span this log is pinned to, or `null` for a trace-level marker
(no span_id on the log, or span not present on the trace tree).

offsetMs.description: Milliseconds from the anchor start (see summary).

message.description: Message preview (full message; FE may truncate).

LogMarker.description:
Timeline marker for a log entry overlaid on a request view.
long LogMarker.OffsetMs is relative to the matched span's
`StartTime` when SpanId? LogMarker.SpanId is set and that span
exists on the trace; otherwise relative to the trace
`StartTime`. When there is no trace (logs-only), offsets are
relative to the earliest log timestamp in the batch (so the first
log sits at 0).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor, or null if no more pages.

hasMore.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

PageOfLogEntry.description:
Cursor-paginated result page. string? Page<T>.Cursor is opaque to clients;
pass it back to the originating endpoint unchanged to fetch the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor, or null if no more pages.

hasMore.description: True when more pages exist beyond this one.

PageOfTraceSummary.description:
Cursor-paginated result page. string? Page<T>.Cursor is opaque to clients;
pass it back to the originating endpoint unchanged to fetch the next page.

RequestViewMode.description:
Degradation mode for a request view (trace + correlated logs).
FE uses this to show a banner when one source is missing.

serviceName.description: `service.name` — required service identity (never empty in well-formed data).

Resource.description:
OpenTelemetry resource describing the entity that produced telemetry
(typically a process / service instance). Small first-class fields for
the common service identity attributes; remaining resource attributes
live in IReadOnlyDictionary<string, string> Resource.Attributes for project predicates and display.

ServiceOperation.description: A single operation (e.g. endpoint or RPC method) belonging to a service.

ServiceSummary.description: Service inventory summary with aggregated metrics across traces.

requestRatePerSec.description: Requests per second, or null when unknown.

errorRatio.description: Error ratio in [0, 1], or null when unknown.

durationP95Ms.description: p95 duration in milliseconds, or null when unknown.

ServiceRedResponse.description: HTTP body for service RED. Null fields mean unknown for that source.

RedSource.description: Whether RED values came from PromQL metrics or span counters (camelCase wire).

Span.description:
A single span within a trace. May have a parent (SpanId? Span.ParentSpanId)
and child spans (IReadOnlyList<SpanEvent> Span.Events captures span events like exceptions).
string Span.Service is a convenience alias of string Resource.ServiceName
kept for module mappers that still read the flat field.

SpanEvent.description: A point-in-time event recorded on a span (e.g. exception, log message).

SpanId.description: Span identifier (typically 16-char hex per OpenTelemetry / Jaeger convention).

SpanKind.description:
OpenTelemetry span kind (OTLP enum values). Distinguishes server/client
RPC, producer/consumer messaging, and internal work.

TraceDetail.description: Full trace with reconstructed span tree. Returned by GET /api/traces/{traceId}.

TraceId.description: Trace identifier (typically 32-char hex per OpenTelemetry / Jaeger convention).

TraceStatus.description: Status of a trace or span, mirroring OpenTelemetry span status codes.

TraceSummary.description: Lightweight trace summary without spans. Returned by GET /api/traces list endpoint.
